sql: SELECT 'alembic_head' AS metric, version_num AS value FROM alembic_version UNION ALL SELECT 'xgame_tables_present', COALESCE(string_agg(table_name, ','), '(none)') FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('game_market_matches','game_tape_snapshots') UNION ALL SELECT 'bot_runs_last_1h', count(*)::text FROM bot_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT 'ladder_total', count(*)::text FROM crypto_ladder_snapshots UNION ALL SELECT 'ladder_last_24h', count(*)::text FROM crypto_ladder_snapshots WHERE captured_at > now() - interval '24 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'ladder_latest_capture', max(captured_at)::text FROM crypto_ladder_snapshots UNION ALL SELECT 'favband_65_90_total', count(*)::text FROM crypto_ladder_snapshots WHERE yes_ask_cents BETWEEN 65 AND 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'favband_65_90_last24h', count(*)::text FROM crypto_ladder_snapshots WHERE yes_ask_cents BETWEEN 65 AND 90 AND captured_at > now() - interval '24 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'favband_last24h_with_model', count(*)::text FROM crypto_ladder_snapshots WHERE yes_ask_cents BETWEEN 65 AND 90 AND model_p IS NOT NULL AND captured_at > now() - interval '24 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'favband_final_hour_24h', count(*)::text FROM crypto_ladder_snapshots WHERE yes_ask_cents BETWEEN 65 AND 90 AND minutes_to_close <= 60 AND captured_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
